title: UNDER THY WINGS
BEDTIME PRAYER
end: The Secret Place — prayers every day

scenes.a: If you are replaying that difficult conversation from earlier, lay your heavy heart down now.
How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God!
therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.
scenes.sub: UNDER THE SHADOW OF HIS WINGS

scenes.a: Father, beneath the quiet cover of tonight, we rest in Your faithful love.
scenes.sub: WE REST IN YOUR FAITHFUL LOVE

scenes.a: Every anxiety that tried to follow us into bed fades away when we remember how deeply we are protected.
Your wings stretch over this room, shielding us from every fear and giving peace to our tired minds.
We let go of tomorrow's decisions and rest securely in Your grace tonight. Amen.
